title: Isotropy Groups of $σ$-Derivations on the Quantum Plane
summary: Let $\Bbbk$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let $\mathcal A_q=\Bbbk_q[x,y]$ be the quantum plane, with $q\in\Bbbk^\ast\setminus\{1\}$. For a fixed automorphism $σ$ of $\mathcal A_q$, we study $σ$-derivations and their isotropy groups under the conjugation action of the centralizer of $σ$ in $\operatorname{Aut}(\mathcal A_q)$. For $q\neq\pm1$, we use Jordan's classification of skew derivations for toric automorphisms, which generalizes the description of Almulhem and Brzeziński for the quantum plane, to describe these groups by character equations on the torus…
